description: This file defines an interface ITransactionCoordinatorGrain for transaction coordination in Orleans, including various transactional methods for grains.

classes.name: ITransactionCoordinatorGrain
classes.description: Interface for a transaction coordinator grain managing multiple transactional operations across grains.

methods.name: MultiGrainSet
methods.description: Sets multiple grains with a specified number.

methods.name: MultiGrainAdd
methods.description: Adds a specified number to multiple grains.

methods.name: MultiGrainDouble
methods.description: Doubles the value in multiple grains.

methods.name: MultiGrainDoubleByRWRW
methods.description: Performs a double operation with RWRW pattern on grains.

methods.name: MultiGrainDoubleByWRWR
methods.description: Performs a double operation with WRWR pattern on grains.

methods.name: OrphanCallTransaction
methods.description: Performs a transaction call on a grain that may be orphaned.

methods.name: AddAndThrow
methods.description: Adds a value to a grain and throws an exception.

methods.name: MultiGrainAddAndThrow
methods.description: Adds a value to multiple grains and throws an exception.

methods.name: MultiGrainSetBit
methods.description: Sets a specific bit in a list of grains.

methods.name: MultiGrainAdd
methods.description: Adds a value to grains using a committer and operation.

methods.name: UpdateViolated
methods.description: Updates a grain in a read-only transaction, possibly to test violation scenarios.
